item: The background-AI status line prints its job state in the page's language and drops the English line that repeated the pill (R291)
summary: _paintAiCoordinator printed the job state (done, cancelled, error) as the server sent it, printed the worker's English detail without its keyed frame, and joined an English 'paused — ... is running' line to the translated pill that says the same. The state word now goes through a closed map of literal t() calls (the keys already existed in all twelve locales; the code never asked for them), a word outside the closed list prints as sent, the running line goes through _framedText with detail_i18n and detail_vars, and the English line is left out while a user's batch holds the model because the pill carries it. Verdict on the detail: src/ai_layer/coordinator.py publishes a Framed line for 'all enabled sweeps are up to date' and per-turn lines; the f-string 'paused — {holders} is running' (coordinator.py:324) is unframed English and its holder reasons stay as sent, a stated limit. Node test drives all five states, an unknown word and a prototype key; the raw-enum ratchet pin for app-diagnostics.js drops 3 to 2.
